Tentative Date of Interview Will be Notified after the Closing Date.

The Annual CTC mentioned is on higher side and CTC payable may vary on Experience/certifications. CTC is inclusive of Gratuity and Medical benefits.
3. Age Limit and other conditions: Minimum Age 21 years Maximum Age 50 years Maximum Age after all relaxations 55 years Age Relaxation for Community Candidate OBC: 03 Years, SCs/ STs: 05 Years and Pw BD: 10 Years. Note: Relaxation is subject to the submission of a valid certificate.
4. Essential Qualification, Eligibility Criteria, Experience : The applicant should satisfy eligibility criteria regarding educational/professional qualifications, length of experience for each post indicated in Annexure- I.
5. Documents Required to Be Attached with the Application Form and Verification : The candidates should attach self
- attested copies of the following documents with the application and should also produce these in original, if they are called for interview: a) Matriculation Certifications (for age proof). b) Certification and mark-sheets in support of the required educational/professional qualifications. c) Candidates currently working in Government/PSUs/Private sector must submit a certificate indicating their length of experience. In case the experience certificate from the current employer is not available, a copy of the appointment letter along with the first and latest pay slips may be submitted. d) Caste certificate (in case applicant belongs to OBC-NCL, EWS, SC and ST). e) Disability Certificate (in case of Pw BD). f) Copy of CV detailing their history of employment and experience, duly signed photograph thereon. g) Photo I.D. Proof and address proof (Passport/ Aadhaar Card/ Driving License/ PAN Card/ Voter ID Card) issued by Central/State Govt. 3 h) “No Objection Certificate” if the candidate is working in any Govt./PSU, attached or subordinate organization or any public body substantially funded by the Govt. The onus is on the candidates to prove with valid documents that all the information submitted by them in the application is true. Note : Number of posts shown above are tentative and may change depending upon the project requirements. Applications finally empaneled after the due process of selection, will be inducted as per actual requirement and progress of the project from time to time.
6. Schemes of selections : a) The selection process will consist of an interview followed by a medical examination . b) Final empanelment will be subject to the candidate being found medically fit. The medical examination will be conducted by a medical authority designated by Rail Tel Corporation of India to assess the candidate's fitness for duties associated with the post. Candidates who do not meet the prescribed medical standards will not be considered for engagement .
7. How to apply : Candidates must apply offline. Duly filled and signed application form ( Annexure-II ), along with relevant enclosures—including copies of educational certificates, community, and experience certificates—should be sent by post/courier to the address below, clearly superscribed as follows, so as to reach on or before the last date of application during office hours i.e. 30.05.2026 Sub : “ APPLICATION FOR TECHNICAL FOR KSWAN PROJECT OF RAILTEL IN SOUTHERN REGION ON CONTRACT BASIS.” “ Territory Manager /SBC , Rail Tel Corporation of India Limited Territory Office, No. 6/1, 12 th Main, Vasanthnagar, Opp. Mount Carmel College Gate-1 Road, BENGALURU
- 560052”
8. Other terms and conditions : a. The decision of Rail Tel regarding all aspects of the application process—including acceptance or rejection of applications, conduct of examination/interview, and final selection—shall be final and binding. Rail Tel reserves the right to alter or modify any condition mentioned in this vacancy notice or any related process as deemed necessary due to unforeseen circumstances or administrative reasons. b. In case of any legal dispute, the jurisdiction shall be Hyderabad . c. Rail Tel Corporation will not be responsible for any inadvertent errors in this vacancy notice and reserves the right to correct such errors. d. Requests for changes to the email ID or address submitted with the application will not be entertained. 4 e. Travelling Expenses: No travelling expenses will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the screening/interview/medical. f. Terms & Tenure of Engagemen t : Engagement is contractual, for 05 years from the date of joinin g. I t may be terminated earlier due to non
- availability of work, unsatisfactory performance, or administrative reasons, at the discretion of the Competent Authority. g. Service Agreement : Selected candidates shall be required to execute a Service Agreement at the time of engagement for a period of one year. While the contractual tenure may be extended, the Service Agreement shall not automatically extend beyond the initial one
- year period. In case of failure to complete the said period, they shall be liable to pay an amount equivalent to three months’ gross salary in addition to serving the applicable notice period or paying salary in lieu thereof. h. Resignation: In addition to the service agreement, a notice period of three months shall be mandatory prior to resignation from Rail Tel Corporation. Serving such notice will not absolve the executive from the financial or other obligations under the service agreement. i. Personal Background and Cr edential Information : The engagement shall be purely on a contractual basis and shall remain provisional, subject to the candidate fulfilling all eligibility conditions and the correctness of the information and documents submitted, including those relatin g to character, antecedents, caste certificate, and other credentials. The candidate shall be solely responsible for the authenticity and validity of the documents and declarations submitted. The organization reserves the right to verify the same at any st age, if deemed necessary. In the event of any discrepancy, suppression of facts, or submission of false information at any stage during the engagement, the contract shall be liable to termination without notice. j. RTI Information: Any application under the RTI Act seeking information will not be entertained until the completion of the entire recruitment process. k. Mode of Communication: Any corrigendum to this notice, further information and updates regarding applications, interview schedules, results, or panels will be published only on the official website of Rail Tel Corporation of India Limited ( www.railtelindia.com ). Call letters for interviews will be sent via email only. No information will be published in any other media. Candidates are advised to regularly check the Rail Tel website and their registered email for updates. l. The responsibility to establish eligibility for the post with reference to all prescribed conditions rests with the applicant. m. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate. n. It is the candidate’s responsibility to ensure they meet the eligibility criteria and provide correct, complete, and required information/documents. Applicants must furnish valid documents substantiating thei r eligibility. No correspondence will be entertained from candidates who are found ineligible or not shortlisted . 5 o. Candidates must not furnish false, tampered, or fabricated documents, nor suppress any material information. Documents containing overwriting or correction marks will not be accepted. p. Rail Tel Corporation will not be responsible for any delay in receipt of the application. Applications received after last date will not be considered. q. WARNING: Beware of touts/job racketeers trying to deceive with false promises of employment in Rail Tel through influence or unfair means. Rail Tel has not authorized any person or agency to act on its behalf in relation to this recruitment. Candidates should rely only on the official website ( www.railtelindia.com ) and beware of fake websites and social media posts by unscrupulous elements. description:
Detailed Vacancy Notice No: RCIL/ER/P&A/Rectt./2025-26/1 Detailed Vacancy Notice No: RCIL/ER/P&A/Rectt./2025-26/1 requirements and performance.
1. Important Dates : Date of Notification 10.07.2025 Date of Closing 30.07.2025 Cutoff date for all eligibility 30.07.2025 Tentative Date of Interview 20.08.2025
2. Details of vacancy to be filled on a contract basis : Name of the Post Contractual Engineer No. of Vacancy 05- Signalling & Telecom and 01- Civil Location Patna, Barauni, Kharagpur, Dhanbad, Bandamunda Note- Locations mentioned above may be changed as per project requirement Scale of Pay Equivalent to E-0 level, Rs. 30,000/-
- 1,20,000/- IDA Reservation UR-03; OBC-02; SC-01. NB: The reservation for SC/ST and OBC will be governed by the prevailing Government guidelines on reservations in recruitment of work-charge posts. Accordingly, if an adequate number of suitable reserved category candidates is not available, the vacancies may be filled by unreserved candidates.
3. Age Limit and other conditions: Minimum Age 24 years Maximum Age 50 years Maximum Age after all relaxations 55 years Age Relaxation for Departmental Candidates Age relaxation shall be granted equivalent to the length of service rendered in Rail Tel. Candidates must have completed a minimum of 03 yrs service in Rail Tel and must remain in service until the date of appointment. An experience certificate, duly issued by an officer of Grade E-5 or above, must be submitted in support of the relaxation claim. 2 Age Relaxation for Community Candidate SC: 05 Years. OBC: 03 Years. NB: Relaxation is subject to the submission of a valid certificate. Community reservation is in addition to the relaxation granted to departmental candidates.
4. Essential Qualification, Eligibility Criteria, Experience : Post Contractual Engineer a). Signalling & Telecom and b). Civil. Minimum qualification criteria a). Contractual Engineer/ Signaling and Telecom
- Full-time Bachelor’s degree in Electronics & Telecom Engg. / Computer Science / Information Technology / Electrical Engg or any of the above combinations in part or whole / M.Sc. Electronics or equivalent. b). Contractual Engineer/Civil
- Full-time Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering. Minimum experience a) Contractual Engineer/ Signaling and Telecom
- Candidates should have total post-qualification experience of minimum 02 years of working in Signal & Telecommunication construction projects dealing with installation/ testing and commissioning of SSI/EI/RRI/PI of indoor and outdoor of Signal & Telecommunication gears for Indian Railways, Metros, Railway sidings/ PSU Railway Sidings/ Private sector Railway sidings. b) Contractual Engineer/ Civil
- Candidates should have a minimum of 2 years post-qualification experience, in the field of project management/ supervision/ Execution of infrastructure Projects in the fields of Railways/ Metro/ Highway/ Bridges/ Ports/ Airports/ Building/ Industrial Sheds/ Tracks, etc. Annual CTC for 1st year per head 07 Lakhs NB: All mandatory educational/professional qualifications must be from recognized universities, autonomous institutes, or government-approved institutions in India. Only experience gained after obtaining the minimum required qualification will be considered for eligibility.
5. Documents Required to Be Attached with the Application Form and Verification : The candidates should attach self-attested copies of the following documents with the application and should also produce these in original, if they are called for interview: a) Matriculation Certifications (for age proof). b) Certificates and mark-sheets in support of the required educational/professional qualifications. c) Certificates in proof of experience, clearly indicating the length and field of 3 experience. d) Caste certificates (in case applicant belongs to SC/ OBC-NCL). e) Copy of CV with signed photograph thereon. f) Copy of the appointment letter in support of appointment to the post in the organization in which currently working along with valid Identity Card/ Current pay slip issued by the company. g) Photo I.D. Proof and address proof (Passport/ Aadhaar Card/ Driving License/ PAN Card/ Voter ID Card) issued by Central/State Govt. h) “No Objection Certificate” if the candidate is working in any Govt./PSU, attached or subordinate organization, or any public body substantially funded by the Govt. NB: The onus is on the candidates to prove with valid documents that all the information submitted by them in the application is true.
6. Schemes of selections : a) The selection process will consist of an interview followed by a medical examination. b) Final empanelment will be subject to the candidate being found medically fit. The medical examination will be conducted by a medical authority designated by Rail Tel Corporation of India to assess the candidate's fitness for duties associated with the post.Candidates who do not meet the prescribed medical standards will not be considered for appointment.
7. How to apply : Candidates must apply offline. Duly filled and signed application form (Annexure-I), along with relevant enclosures—including copies of educational certificates, community, and experience certificates—should be sent by post/courier to the address below, clearly superscribed as follows, so as to reach on or before the last date of application during office hours. Sub: ÄPPLICATION FOR TECHNICAL PERSONNEL FOR SIGNALLING PROJECTS OF RAILTEL ON CONTRACT BASIS. To, Assistant General Manager/P&A/ER Rail Tel Corporation of India Limited, Eastern Region, 19th Floor, Aurora Waterfront Building, Plot no. 34/1, Block -GN, Sector
- V, Salt Lake City, Kolkata -700091, West Bengal. 4
8. Other terms and conditions: a. The decision of Rail Tel regarding all aspects of the recruitment process—including acceptance or rejection of applications, conduct of examination/interview, and final selection—shall be final and binding. Rail Tel reserves the right to alter or modify any condition mentioned in this vacancy notice or any related process as deemed necessary due to unforeseen circumstances or administrative reasons. b. In case of any legal dispute, the jurisdiction shall be Kolkata. c. Rail Tel Corporation will not be responsible for any inadvertent errors in this vacancy notice and reserves the right to correct such errors. d. Requests for changes to the email ID or address submitted with the application will not be entertained. e. Travelling Expenses: No travelling expenses will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the screening/interview. f. Terms & Tenure of Engagement: Engagement is contractual, initially for one year from the date of joining, and may be extended based on project requirements and performance. It may be terminated earlier due to non-availability of work, unsatisfactory performance, or administrative reasons, at the discretion of the Competent Authority. g. Resignation: A notice period of three months shall be mandatory prior to resignation from Rail Tel Corporation. Serving such notice will not absolve the executive from financial or other obligations under the service agreement. In case of shorter Notice, they shall be liable to pay an amount equivalent to 03 months gross salary. h. Service Agreement: Selected candidates will be required to execute a service agreement at the time of appointment, committing to serve the organization for a period of one year. In case of failure to complete the said period, they shall be liable to pay an amount equivalent to three months’ gross salary. In addition to notice period required in case of resignation. i. Background Check: Selection/appointment shall be provisional, subject to verification of character, antecedents, caste certificate, and other submitted documents, as well as fulfilment of medical and other conditions applicable to appointments under the Central Government/PSUs. j. RTI Information: Any application under the RTI Act seeking information will not be entertained until the completion of the entire recruitment process. k. Mode of Communication: Any corrigendum to this notice, further information and updates regarding applications, interview schedules, results, or panels will be 5 published only on the official website of Rail Tel Corporation of India Limited (www.railtelindia.com). Call letters for interviews will be sent via email only. No information will be published in any other media. Candidates are advised to regularly check the Rail Tel website and their registered email for updates. l. The responsibility to establish eligibility for the post with reference to all prescribed conditions rests with the applicant. m. It is the candidate’s responsibility to ensure they meet the eligibility criteria and provide correct, complete, and required information/documents. Applicants must furnish valid documents substantiating their eligibility. No correspondence will be entertained from candidates who are found ineligible or not shortlisted. n. Candidates must not furnish false, tampered, or fabricated documents, nor suppress any material information. Documents containing overwriting or correction marks will not be accepted. o. Rail Tel Corporation will not be responsible for any delay in receipt of the application. Applications received after last date will not be considered. p. Declaration of Prior Applications: At the time of interview, candidates shall be required to submit an undertaking declaring whether they have applied for any position (including where results are declared, awaited, or under process) in any Central/State Government organization, including CPSEs. If no such applications exist, the candidate must explicitly state that they have not applied elsewhere.
9. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.
10. WARNING: Beware of touts/job racketeers trying to deceive with false promises of employment in Rail Tel through influence or unfair means. Rail Tel has not authorized any person or agency to act on its behalf in relation to this recruitment. Candidates should rely only on the official website (www.railtelindia.com) and beware of fake websites and social media posts by unscrupulous elements. title: Advisor/RCIL
description:
Detailed Vacancy notice for Advisor/CO/RCIL Detailed Vacancy notice for Advisor/CO/RCIL service management systems, respectively. 1.1 Rail Tel has a strategic relationship with the Indian Railways and it undertakes a wide variety of projects including provision of mission critical connectivity services like IP based video surveillance system at station, e-Office’ services and implementing short haul connectivity between stations and long haul connectivity to support various organization within the Indian Railways. Rail Tel also provide various passenger services including content on demand services and Wi-Fi across major railway stations in India. 2, Rail Tel Corporation is a Listed Company and requires dynamic, experienced and result oriented retired officers at level-14/15 in CDA Pay Matrix (7" CPC), preferable to Deptt. of Telecom (DOT)/ Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) Ministry of Communications for coordination, lesioning with various agencies, DOT in various matters and advising on growth of tele-communication business. The requirement, eligibility criteria etc. are as under:- S.No. | Name of post Number Eligibility required 01 Advisor/CO 01 Retired at Level-14/15 in CDA Pay Matrix (7*" CPC).
3. Experience- Candidates should have working experience in the following field of work: The Candidate should have more than 30 years of experience in telecom infra related work Job Profile: coordination, lesioning with various agencies, DOT in various matters and advising on growth of tele-communication business.
4. Duration of the Service Contract- Duration of Service Contract will be initially for a period of 1 year, further extendable till requirement of services or attaining age of 65 years whichever is earlier.
5. Age criteria- Age should not be more than 64 years as on 01.05.2025.
6.
